title: [E-Document Formats] Fix defects in V2 draft migration for XRechnung, PINT A-NZ and Factura-E
summary: Fixes defects in the V2 draft import for XRechnung, PINT A-NZ and Factura-E. Re-reading an XRechnung draft no longer duplicates lines, and unsupported root elements or namespaces are rejected. PINT A-NZ vendor-matching fallbacks now receive values. Credit notes and corrective invoices now map the original invoice reference so they can be applied.
key_points: XRechnung: ReadIntoDraft now calls ResetDraft, so re-runs no longer duplicate lines, and ResetDraft no longer errors when no draft header exists
XRechnung: unsupported root elements or unexpected namespaces are now rejected with an error
PINT A-NZ: vendor ID, name and address are now returned to the vendor-matching fallbacks, and credit notes map the billing reference to Applies-to Ext. Invoice No.
Factura-E: the corrective invoice number now maps to Applies-to Ext. Invoice No. instead of Purchase Order No.
Three XRechnung regression tests added, mirroring the OIOUBL suite
